hash_domain_contract.canonical_content_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with the content_sha256 member omitted
hash_domain_contract.serialized_file_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete UTF-8 JSON file including content_sha256 and formatting
hash_domain_contract.identity_rule: Both design verdicts bind canonical_content_sha256; serialized_file_sha256 verifies archived bytes only.

scope.purpose: extract and prove a reusable internal qualification engine from the accepted Phase 1 mechanisms

dependency_rules: generic modules import no Dashboard production package
domain model and oracle import generic contracts but no production evaluator
oracle and production adapter cannot import each other
production adapter returns observations and cannot define expected outcomes
reporters cannot change canonical verdict or finding severity
engine accepts only an isolated fixture root or explicit read-only snapshot

blocking_cases: accepted terminal with outgoing repair obligation
root blocker without recovery or explicit quarantine
missing effect allowlist or uninstrumented write primitive
ignored observation field without non-semantic rationale
output path or symlink escape from result root
model_validation.unknown_value_rule: Reject; never coerce an unknown production value to a known state.
model_validation.execution_rule: Invalid models fail before production execution.

exploration_and_coverage.finite_graph: complete reachability plus SCC analysis with deterministic shortest counterexample
exploration_and_coverage.production_execution: separately bounded; exhaustion is COVERAGE-INCOMPLETE and cannot pass

decision_strategy.larger_tables: deterministic pairwise plus mandatory critical combinations

exploration_and_coverage.progress_rule: Only semantic axes and immutable identities can prove progress; volatile-only change cannot.

effects_faults_and_concurrency.effect_capture: record each configured append replace or delete attempt before invocation; classify project store outside runtime outbound hardware and capture final tree
effects_faults_and_concurrency.recovery_rule: Each required fault point proves rollback or exact-key roll-forward using a fresh process or workbench instance.

outputs.junit_xml: verified projection preserving verdict and exact stable IDs and severities of every blocking item
outputs.text: verified concise projection preserving verdict and exact stable IDs and severities of every blocking item

exit_codes.0: valid run with no blocking finding or unknown required obligation
exit_codes.2: invalid model fixture output contract or runner; production execution did not begin

design_acceptance.requirement: Enforced dependency direction keeps generic modules production-free and separates oracle from adapter.
Immutable typed contracts cover state transition observation finding counterexample and report.
Pre-execution validation rejects unknown semantics broken graph recovery instrumentation and path contracts.
Complete finite exploration is separate from bounded production execution; incomplete coverage cannot pass.
Decision coverage combines exhaustive pairwise critical-combination and MC/DC obligations.
Historical capability requires direct support executable migration or explicit quarantine.
Attempt-level effects named faults fresh-instance recovery and deterministic interleavings are first-class evidence.
Every required mutant must be killed; survivors block.
Canonical JSON owns the verdict; JUnit text and exit codes cannot hide or downgrade blockers.
Phase 2 is Permission-only proof of reuse and preserves Phase 1 rev3 without Phase 3 or productization claims.

planned_implementation_evidence: Permission adapter oracle and fixture hashes
fault attempt-level effect and deterministic concurrency evidence
canonical JSON JUnit text projection and exit-code evidence

requested_verdict.agreement_condition: Both reviewers explicitly accept P2D-01 through P2D-10 against this exact canonical content hash before implementation starts.
